West Texas Intermediate, which tracks US crude, rose 3.55 per cent to hit $101.41, the first time it has topped $100 in nearly a month. For the week, Brent gained nearly 5 per cent, while WTI jumped by more than 10 per cent. Both traded lower earlier in the session.

articles.dek: Did President Donald Trump invent a fictional sailor in order to justify wasting billions of dollars to put old-fashioned technology on naval aircraft carriers?
